sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', at) AS hr, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind='disconnected') AS disc, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind='connected') AS conn, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind='discovery') AS disco, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind='thread_started') AS starts FROM incentive_collector_events WHERE at >= now() - interval '30 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
